tasks.goal: CLIのused memory量を妥当性検査付きで表示
tasks.interface: Preserve existing signatures, surrounding source and all protected tests. Implement used_memory(total: u64, available: u64) -> String. If total is zero or available exceeds total, return unavailable. Otherwise return N KiB used, N=total-available in unsigned decimal. Equal nonzero values are valid and yield 0 KiB used. No rounding, percentages, wrapping arithmetic or change to observation/audit.
constraints: Single responsibility. No dependency/public API/authority changes. Do not change any other behavior.
